summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.24/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.24 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 27, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 19¢ lower than a week ago, $1.21 lower than a month ago, and 57¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($2.97) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.59).
